sn46.26:2.1: Here (and at [sn46.28:2.1]()) the terms beginning with “abundant” are added to the usual formula; they are more familiar from the divine meditations ([sn42.8:12.1]()).
sn46.26:2.2: Here we find a succinct presentation of the three “rounds” of dependent origination: defilements, deeds, and results. See [sn12.38:1.2]() and note for discussion.
